name: aether-wcag-scanner
description: WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility scanner with RAG-powered fix generation. Scans live URLs via Playwright + axe-core across desktop, tablet, and mobile viewports and returns violations paired with corpus-backed fixes and WCAG technique references.

api_key.description: Optional Allchemy Labs API key. Enables RAG-powered fixes from the hosted insights engine. Without it, the scanner still works fully offline using built-in fix templates.
